title: WhatsApp Cloud event
description: One verified Cloud API message or delivery status, published after archive commit. This is the callback payload, not the entire webhook. Delivery is best effort; reconcile with the Cloud archive when necessary.

business_account_id.description: Meta WhatsApp Business Account ID that received the webhook.

phone_number_id.description: Meta Phone Number ID, not the displayed telephone number.

chat_id.description: Normalized sender for incoming messages, or recipient for delivery status events. No internal cloud: prefix.

sender_id.description: Normalized sender; present only for message.received.

message_type.description: Exact raw Meta message type; present only for message.received. May include future types that the archive preview cannot render.

text.description: Optional message preview, limited to 16 KiB of UTF-8 text, or 8 KiB if data must be omitted to bound the event. Omitted when empty.

status.description: Delivery state; present only for message.status.

timestamp_ms.description: Meta's event timestamp converted from Unix seconds to Unix milliseconds, not local receipt time.

data.description: Original individual Meta message or status object. If the serialized event would exceed 64 KiB, replaced with {"content_omitted":true}; text is also clipped to 8 KiB. This object is not the webhook envelope.
